opis: King se trudi spopasti s sestrino novo neodvisnostjo, McKay pa s seboj pripelje Ogilvieja, da bi pomagal pri zdravljenju bolnika na terenu. Bolnike in osebje spravi v zadrego nepričakovana navzočnost nekoga na urgenci.
igralci: Noah Wyle (Dr. Michael Robby Robinavitch), Patrick Ball (Dr. Frank Langdon), Katherine LaNasa (Charge Nurse Dana Evans), Fiona Dourif (Dr. Cassie McKay), Taylor Dearden (Dr. Melissa King), Isa Briones (Dr. Trinity Santos), Gerran Howell (Dr. Dennis Whitaker), Gerran Howell (Med Student Dennis Whitaker), Shabana Azeez (Med Student Victoria Javadi), Amielynn Abellera (Nurse Perlah Alawi), Supriya Ganesh (Dr. Samira Mohan)
